description: Ownership / share capital structure of a French company, extracted by AI from the latest PUBLIC articles of association filed at the INPI registry: share capital, legal form, shareholders (CORPORATE holders named with role and ownership %, natural persons COUNTED with their % and never named since 2026-09-19 in associes_personnes_physiques and detenu_par_personnes_physiques_pct, under GDPR and CJEU C-798/24), notable clauses, with confidence and the source document. Reconstructed from public filed deeds: NOT a beneficial-ownership register (RBE) or a beneficial-owner identification. A SIREN of a unit the INSEE publishes partially (a sole trader who objected to the publication of their data) that is not proven to be a legal person returns 404 diffusion_partielle, not charged: its articles carry the person and their extraction is not served. Paid via x402 ($0.35 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_capital

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
